android.desc:
Join thousands of people discovering food like never before with DishDex, your guide to local dishes anywhere in the world.

Whether you are traveling abroad, exploring your own city, or reading a menu, DishDex helps you instantly understand what is on the plate.

🌍 Explore by place
• Browse dishes by country or region
• Learn what locals eat and what makes each dish unique

🍴 Get the details that matter
• Clear descriptions, ingredients and origins
• Know exactly what you are ordering before you taste it

✅ Find food that fits you
• Filter by dietary needs, vegan, vegetarian, pescetarian, halal, kosher and more
• Choose by dish type, breakfast, main meals, soup or stew, street food, barbecue and desserts
• Set preferences for favorite ingredients, spice levels, or allergens to avoid

📍 Recommended restaurants
• Discover places that serve the dish you are viewing
• Includes well known and trusted restaurant suggestions, with quick access to Google Maps
• Rolling out gradually, not available for every dish yet

⭐ Save your favorites
• Add dishes to Favorites with one tap
• View, manage and remove saved dishes anytime

📷 Visual insights
• Authentic images and background info from trusted sources

💬 Available languages
• English, German, French, Japanese

💡 Why DishDex
Food is culture. DishDex helps you not just eat, but experience the flavors of every place you go. Perfect for travelers, food lovers and anyone curious about what is on their plate.

✨ Plans
• Free Plan: 3 searches per day
• Premium Plan: unlimited daily searches with a monthly subscription

🔒 Privacy and simplicity
• No account required
• No ads
• No trackers
• Images and background info come from trusted sources

🚀 Coming soon
• More languages
• More features and improvements

DishDex makes every meal easier, smarter and more exciting, wherever you are.

quotes.text:
Browse by country or region. See ingredients. Filter by diet. Android is live today; iOS arrives in a few days.

Since it's version 1.0, there are still bugs to fix and images to improve, but I'm working on it.

Ever sat down in a new place and stared at the menu thinking, "What is that?" I kept googling dish names while traveling, so I built DishDex.

What it does
 • Browse by place: pick a country or region and see its dishes.
 • Know what's in it: clear descriptions, ingredients, and origins.
 • Filter fast: vegan, vegetarian, pescetarian, halal/kosher, and more.
 • Pick your style: main meals, street food, BBQ, desserts.
 • Personalize: choose favorite ingredients, avoid allergens, set your spice level.

Why it's nice
 • No account required. No ads. No trackers.
 • Images and background info come from trusted sources.
 • Free plan with daily searches; Pro unlocks unlimited.

Coming soon
iOS release in a few days.

New features coming soon
Save favorites and multilingual support.

Get it
 • Android (live): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.marco.dishdex
 • iOS: coming in a few days
 • Website: https://dishdex.io

Thanks for checking it out! I would love feedback on what you want me to add next.
